Armaf CDNIM Pure Parfum — ₹4,900–₹6,545: Citrus/woody, formal and versatile. Nykaa currently lists ₹6,545; reviews report strong longevity, though batch performance varies. 
Nykaa

Lattafa Khamrah — ~₹3,960–₹4,785: Sweet, warm, luxurious; particularly suited to evening/winter weddings. 
Nykaa

For a 50-person Indian company, switching costs are mostly implementation, data migration, traveller retraining and contract exit costs rather than a published subscription price. All three below currently operate in India.

Provider	Cost visibility	Switching effort	Main practical friction
Cleartrip OOO
	No subscription/extra platform fee publicly stated; booking costs are quote/transaction dependent. 
OOO by Cleartrip
	Low–medium	Reconfigure policies, approvals, GST/reporting and employee profiles.
Thomas Cook India Corporate Travel
	Custom quotation	Medium	More service-model configuration; dedicated staff, booking tools and 24/7 support may require implementation work. 
Thomas Cook

FCM Travel India
	Custom enterprise quotation	Medium–high	Integrations, policy configuration, reporting and expense-system connections can make migration more involved. 
FCM Travel

Bottom line: Cleartrip presents the simplest publicly documented commercial model; Thomas Cook and FCM are more bespoke. Before switching, obtain each provider's implementation fee, per-booking/service fees in ₹, minimum contract term, termination notice, data-export rights and migration support—these aren't publicly standardized.
